title: Setup: build TinkerPop gremlin-core and tinkergraph at both #3105 revisions and run the dedup regressions
description: Setup for case M10 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-m01-m10-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-m01-m10/worktrees, Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 11, -pl gremlin-core,tinkergraph-gremlin -am (gremlin-language, gremlin-shaded, gremlin-core, gremlin-test, tinkergraph-gremlin; no .NET, Go, Python or JS modules): builds TinkerPop 3.8.0-SNAPSHOT at the fix pin a97db03618fa2fd7c17d24e331ff62adfe9c8df4 (online first, then offline) and the parent pin 007fd228a992f1dccba22e25a88e647168e5ba4f, running DedupGlobalStepTest and TinkerGraphFeatureTest with cucumber.features set to filter/Dedup.feature; keeps the five module jars, the DedupGlobalStep class digests and tinkergraph-gremlin's runtime classpath; then puts the fix's DedupGlobalStepTest and Dedup.feature on a copy of the parent (expected to fail). The module builds take several minutes, so the runs are a job. External dependencies were resolved inline first (dependency:go-offline on the same modules).
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent pass online and offline; the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED; the trees are removed
